business.name: Pandora's Snowballs And Soft Serve Ice Cream

ranking.name: Pandora's Snowballs And Soft Serve Ice Cream

text.text_excerpt: After a warm day of walking in City Park, I headed over to Pandora's with my sister for a treat. This was my first time having a Snowball and it was really good. Pandora's is a window that you order from. There are so many different flavors to choose from! Great variety. It seems like there is a constant flow of people at Pandora's. After you place your order, you can watch the person make your Snowball! I've had shaved ice before, but Pandora's shaved ice is shaved very fine, which is nice. They also don't skimp on the flavoring. There aren't seats, but you can go to the island and sit at the bus stop! Just a suggestion. Great place to cool down and enjoy a Snowball!

Lately I can't take a trip to City Park without also taking a trip to Pandora's. I come to Pandora's for their unique flavor combinations, especially their cream flavors. They have everything from Banana's Foster to white chocolate. On my last trip I got the grasshopper. The chocolate and mint were incredibly refreshing on an August day. I like that Pandora's offers a very small, kiddie size so I can have just a little bit of sweet for the day and still get cooled off. People complain about the wait, but every good snowball shop in New Orleans in the summer is going to have a line, so order your snowball, get in line, and anticipate that sweet, ice cold snow!

MMMMMMM Pandora's. I love this place. Juicy tasty snowballs in my neighborhood with a friendly staff! Their ice isn't as super soft as hansens or plums but it's pretty fine. None of that course ice chip crap here. I'm particularly fond of their off menu flavors like Strawberry Iced Tea or Strawberry Lemonade. Not too sweet but very flavorful. They will experiment for you so feel free to mix it up. You can also let them know how juicy or icy you want your snowball. They have a pretty good selection of sugar free and quite a few creamy flavors too. They tend to have a line (why? because they got tasty 'balls! LOL) but they move quick. The street parking sucks. I recommend parking a block do...
